summary_brief: 今日(9/18，上一日报为9/16)是AI编码代理生态的延续推进日，无方向性转折，四条既有主线出现多项目同日合流并新增落地：①实时流式/多模态交互基座集体落地——openai-python托管WebSocket会话、Goose桌面语音、Codex /voice、Playwright视频录制，把9/12起的"语音+屏幕交互范式"推向一等公民基础设施；②企业级安全加固成为普适主题——Codex一日十余项沙箱逃逸/跨平台权限路由修复、Claude Code插件漏洞、Cline可执行文件劫持、Turborepo路径穿越、OpenClaw命令注入与凭据泄露，延续9/12以来的攻击面防线落地；③远程/云原生开发收敛——Cline SSH远程、云端Hub会话、代理远端文件与800MB级大附件流式上传，深化9/15主线；④类型安全与模型路由中间件抽象兴起——langchain同日发布langchain-typesafe实验包/TypeSafeClassifier/AutoMode与ModelRouter中间件，DeepAgents迁移FastMCP、acpx引入共享会话抽象，从单体实现走向可插拔标准化层。真正的相对历史新增点集中在四个方向：OAuth凭据集中脱敏成为模型网关多供应商接入的核心基建(PKCE登录、token缓存刷新、诊断全链路脱敏)；Agent技能/包能力资产化分发(Dify外部URL导入.ifpkg、roster包导出)；Agent能力评测标准化加速(Phoenix Harbor基准、Stagehand 102项HardBench)；新一代高性价比模型(Gemini 3.8、audio-mini)持续适配。整体处于"远程多端协作+凭据安全+可移植能力资产"的多点收口，密集多但有方向感。

engineering_signals.title: AI 实时流式交互基座集体落地（WebSocket 会话/流式传输）
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: openai-python 新增托管 WebSocket 会话（PR 与 commit 双重出现），配合 prompt 缓存预热、gamini 3.8/GPT-Live 支持，说明模型 SDK 正将实时双向流式交互提升为一等公民能力，为实时 AI 应用提供基础设施。

engineering_signals.title: 多模态实时交互成为编码代理新方向（语音对话/视频）
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Goose 桌面新增语音对话、Codex TUI 新增 /voice、Playwright 支持自定义帧率视频录制，多项目同时从文本交互向语音/视频实时交互扩展，标志 agent 交互范式从纯文本走向多模态。

engineering_signals.title: 类型安全与模型路由中间件抽象深化（langchain 生态）
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: langchain 同日发布 langchain-typesafe 第一方包、TypeSafeClassifier、AutoModeMiddleware 与 ModelRouterMiddleware，标志 LLM 应用框架从功能堆叠转向可组合的、类型驱动的中间件架构。

engineering_signals.title: 企业级安全加固成为普适主题（沙箱逃逸/路径穿越/凭据泄露）
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Codex 修复多个沙箱逃逸并强化 Windows 沙箱、Turborepo 封堵缓存归档路径穿越、Claude Code 修复插件执行漏洞、Cline 修复可执行文件劫持、OpenClaw 修复命令注入与凭据泄露、OpenAI 集中 OAuth 登录脱敏，多项目同日集中推送安全修复，反映 AI 工具安全已进入严肃合规阶段。

engineering_signals.title: 跨平台沙箱权限策略重构（Windows/Linux 一致性）
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Codex 同日多项 PR 重构沙箱抽象：读写按权限独立路由、按执行器 OS 校验套接字、MXC 后端支持、cwd 消失保留策略上下文、平台身份统一抽象，说明沙箱正在从单一实现走向可组合、跨平台的策略引擎。

engineering_signals.title: Agent 化工程维护全链路（AI 升级工具/自动维护）
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Next.js 新增 `next upgrade --ai` 让代理自动检测并升级框架，AI 从代码补全扩展到依赖升级、安全修补等工程维护领域，这是 agentic 开发工具渗透全链路的标志性信号。

engineering_signals.title: 构建工具链性能与内存激优化（Turbopack/桌面端）
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Turbopack 改用 lz4_flex、按族分片持久化存储、GC 配置化，openCode 桌面端修复 msgpack 缓冲区并以结构化克隆根治 38MB 对象延迟，多个项目针对大型数据集的 I/O 与内存进行深度优化，反映 agent 处理大规模上下文的硬性性能需求。

engineering_signals.title: Agent 远端文件与大附件处理能力扩展
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: openCode 新增 fs.write 服务端点、任意文件附件交付与流式上传（800MB 级），gptme 接入语义向量搜索，多家同时发展 agent 处理大型/远端数据的能力，标志编码代理从单文件编辑迈向大数据集处理。

engineering_signals.title: MCP 交互与多代理安全边界建立
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Codex 让需人工输入的 MCP 请求限定根线程、弃用 connector_id 改 URL 隧道识别、OpenClaw 设置页支持连接器登录，多项目为多代理/子代理场景下的 MCP 授权与人工交互建立安全边界，同时推进 MCP 连接模型演进。

engineering_signals.title: Agent 能力评估基准集体扩充（HardBench/TRAIL/Harbor）
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Stagehand 引入 102 个 HardBench 任务、Phoenix 新增 Harbor 基准评测、Promptfoo 支持多模型评测，多个浏览器代理与评测框架同日扩充基准与评测能力，反映业界开始用统一标准度量 agent 能力。

engineering_signals.title: 多代理协调与共享运行时基础设施
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: JCodex 新增共享 daemon 自动启动与 --no-daemon 绕过选项、Cline 支持远程 SSH 并行子代理、OpenClaw 跨进程同步模型偏好并隔离 MCP 会话，多个代理框架正在从单代理走向可编排、可并行、跨进程共享运行时的架构。

release_signals.title: Claude Code 网关与技能同步
release_signals.why_it_matters: Claude Code 新增网关登录确认、技能/插件与 claude.ai 账户同步，以及 ctrl+enter 发送队列消息，显著增强了企业级身份管理和跨端工作流一致性。

release_signals.title: Claude Code 安全加固
release_signals.why_it_matters: 修复了插件安装脚本执行、Git LFS 指针下载、路径遍历等多个安全漏洞，并强化了沙箱命令权限检查，提升了整体安全性。

release_signals.title: Claude Code 可观测性增强
release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增 OTel 事件（如 managed_settings_resolved）和 LLM 请求 effort 属性，并优化了网关启动和负载下的性能，为开发者提供了更细粒度的监控和调试能力。

release_signals.title: Cline 桌面版远程 SSH 支持
release_signals.why_it_matters: Cline 桌面应用新增 SSH 远程开发能力，允许本地 UI 连接远程机器，并支持并行子代理，大幅扩展了其作为 AI 编程助手的适用场景。

release_signals.title: Cline 安全与稳定性修复
release_signals.why_it_matters: 修复了 Windows 下可执行文件搜索路径劫持漏洞，并优化了长任务压缩逻辑，防止上下文溢出，提升了工具的安全性和可靠性。

release_signals.title: OpenAI Python SDK 新功能
release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增 agent session 模型设置、audio-mini 模型、compaction 进度事件、托管 WebSocket 会话和 prompt-cache 预热，为开发者提供了更丰富的 API 能力。

release_signals.title: OpenHands 代理配置增强
release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增为代理配置文件选择 secrets 和保存的代理配置文件的功能，并支持 Docker 运行时设置转发，增强了代理的可配置性和灵活性。

release_signals.title: LangChain 类型安全中间件
release_signals.why_it_matters: 发布实验性的 langchain-typesafe 包，引入 TypeSafeClassifier、AutoModeMiddleware 和 ModelRouterMiddleware，为 LLM 应用提供了类型安全和智能路由的新抽象层。

release_signals.title: Codex 语音交互与安全增强
release_signals.why_it_matters: Codex TUI 新增实验性 /voice 语音对话、实时推理摘要和 Touch ID 验证，并修复了多个沙箱逃逸漏洞，提升了交互体验和安全性。

release_signals.title: Promptfoo 多模型支持扩展
release_signals.why_it_matters: Promptfoo 新增对 Gemini 3.8、GPT-Live 语音、OpenAI Agents API 和 Ollama 0.34 的支持，并引入可移植的 HTTP/MCP 配置模式，巩固了其作为 LLM 评测工具的地位。

release_signals.title: OpenClaw 安全与稳定性更新
release_signals.why_it_matters: OpenClaw 扩展稳定版修复了大量安全漏洞（如命令注入、凭证泄露）和消息传递问题，并增强了网关可靠性，是面向生产环境的重要更新。

release_signals.title: Vercel SDK 破坏性变更
release_signals.why_it_matters: Vercel TypeScript SDK 移除了 KMS 签发者的 edDsa 算法枚举，并调整了用户事件和项目权限的响应结构，属于破坏性变更，需要开发者关注。

release_signals.title: vercel/ai 批量发版 100 个子包（1 个值得注意）
release_signals.why_it_matters: vercel/ai 本批 100 个子包集中发版本质上是例行版本同步与小修小补：几乎所有子包仅因核心依赖升级而 patch 跟随，核心 ai 包及若干 provider 各带少量流式处理与兼容性 bugfix，不含任何 breaking changes 或 major 跳跃。唯一实质新增能力是 @ai-sdk/quiverai 对 Arrow 2 SVG 动画的 generateImage 支持，整体影响较低。

releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.summary:
- Cline starts again after updating. In 0.0.31 the app could fail at launch with "desktop backend exited before publishing its endpoint" and never reach the workspace picker. Cline runs its own copy of the Cline Hub in the background, and the two halves had been built from different copies of the same code — so the Hub announced one build identity while the app expected another, the app shut down the very Hub it had just started, and startup timed out reporting "No compatible hub runtime is available". Both halves now load the same copy of that code, and the real compiled backend is now booted end-to-end in CI on every change so the two cannot drift apart again

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cline/cline/compare/desktop-v0.0.31...desktop-v0.0.32

key_changes: 修复了从 0.0.31 升级后应用无法启动的问题，此前会报错 'desktop backend exited before publishing its endpoint' 并无法进入工作区选择界面
修复了 Cline 与后台 Hub 因代码副本不一致导致的构建标识漂移问题，应用会错误地关闭刚启动的 Hub 并导致启动超时
现在前后端两侧加载同一份代码副本，确保构建标识一致
CI 流水线现已在每次变更时对真实的编译后端进行端到端启动测试，防止两侧再次发生漂移
ai_summary.summary_cn: 此版本修复了 Cline 桌面应用在更新后（0.0.31 升级时）无法启动的严重问题。问题根源在于应用与其后台 Hub 使用了不同副本的代码，导致构建标识不一致，应用误将自身刚启动的 Hub 关闭并陷入启动超时。现在已统一代码副本并通过 CI 端到端测试彻底防止此类问题再次发生。

releases.summary:
## 2026.7.33

This is the July 2026 Extended Stable release, covering the Gateway, official npm plugins, and matching Docker images.

### Highlights

- **Security and credential safety:** harden command parsing, browser origin checks, plugin Git installs, diagnostics, service credentials, and webhook logging across Gateway and official plugins.
- **Message and session integrity:** preserve queued, imported, streamed, and tool-result messages across retries, hooks, recovery, and channel lifecycle transitions.
- **Gateway reliability:** close failed HTTP and Responses streams, bound expensive reads and history queries, and settle shutdown work before reporting completion. Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Channel delivery:** repair Discord, Matrix, Telegram, Slack, WhatsApp, LINE, Feishu, Zalo, and meeting-plugin edge cases that could lose, corrupt, or stall messages.
- **Provider and media robustness:** bound provider requests and diagnostics, reject malformed payloads, and preserve valid tool schemas and response lifecycles. Thanks @RomneyDa.

### Changes

- **Extended-stable release tooling:** carry the current Docker channel classifier, promoter, verification policy, and tests so `v2026.7.33` can move only the `extended-stable*` aliases. Thanks @RomneyDa.

### Fixes

- **Security boundaries:** reject escaped-newline command words, exact-origin mismatches, injected Git option arguments, inherited secret-response identifiers, unsafe browser mutations, and malformed or oversized node payloads.
- **Delivery and transcript recovery:** keep retry delays accurate, preserve imported messages and plugin-blocked tool results, retain detached admissions, and avoid silently dropping channel actions or recovery work. Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Resource and lifecycle safety:** bound catalog, history, media, stderr, API, and provider waits; stop canceled parallel tools; drain channel shutdown; and reject queued worker requests after close. Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Text and schema correctness:** preserve UTF-16 boundaries across user-visible truncation paths, keep root tool-schema properties, reject non-finite schema values, and report exact UTF-8 write sizes.
- **Official plugins:** repair message parsing, proxy paths, request timeouts, media handling, privacy-safe logging, and runtime aliases across the npm-published plugin inventory.

### Complete contribution record

This audited record covers the complete v2026.7.1-2..42625327f91254cfe66cbeb6d7a1812780b1a694 history: 126 merged PRs. The generation manifest also supplies direct commits as editorial input; the grouped notes above prioritize user impact.

ClawX - Graphical AI Assistant based on OpenClaw

Please select the appropriate installer for your operating system and architecture:

#### macOS

- **Intel (x64)**: `ClawX-*-mac-x64.dmg`

#### Windows

- **AppImage (x64)**: `ClawX-*-linux-x86_64.AppImage` (Universal format, recommended)
- **AppImage (ARM64)**: `ClawX-*-linux-arm64.AppImage`
- **Debian/Ubuntu (x64)**: `ClawX-*-linux-amd64.deb`
- **Debian/Ubuntu (ARM64)**: `ClawX-*-linux-arm64.deb`
- **RPM (x64)**: `ClawX-*-linux-x86_64.rpm`

### 📝 Release Notes

See the auto-generated release notes below for detailed changes.

### ⚠️ Installation Notes

- **macOS**: On first launch, you may see "cannot verify developer". Go to System Preferences → Security & Privacy to allow the app to run
- **Windows**: SmartScreen may block the app. Click "More info" → "Run anyway" to proceed
- **Linux AppImage**: First run `chmod +x ClawX-*.AppImage` to add execute permission. On Ubuntu 22.04 you may also need `sudo apt install libfuse2`; on Ubuntu 24.04 use `sudo apt install libfuse2t64`
- **Linux .deb (Ubuntu 24.04)**: If installation fails due to missing dependencies, use `sudo apt install libgtk-3-0t64 libnotify4t64 libxss1t64` before installing

releases.author: ashwin-ant
releases.summary:
## What's changed

- Added the signed-in account to Claude apps gateway sign-in: when the gateway names it, you confirm it before the credential is saved, and `/status` shows it
- Added a send-now key (ctrl+enter, or ctrl+x ctrl+s) that interrupts the current turn and sends all queued messages at once; sent and queued messages show in gray until the model receives them
- Added a startup warning when a configured `otelHeadersHelper` fails, so sessions that silently export no telemetry are noticed
- Added syncing of the skills and plugins enabled on your claude.ai account to terminal sessions signed in with it; opt out with `syncClaudeAiSkills: false` or `syncClaudeAiPlugins: false`
- Added `/plugin install <plugin> --marketplace <source>`, which offers to add the marketplace before installing the plugin
- Fixed a restored memory file's age note changing between requests after a compaction or resume, which caused prompt cache misses
- Fixed `--forward-subagent-text` stream-json and SDK output dropping the messages of subagents spawned by a `context: fork` skill, and of forked skills invoked by a subagent or another forked skill
- Fixed @-mention file suggestions being buried below MCP resources when using a custom `fileSuggestion` command or typing `@.`/`@./`
- Fixed fullscreen mode placing background-task completion notices beneath a long turn's collapsed tool row instead of where they arrived; each notice now closes the open row
- Fixed `claude plugin marketplace update` deleting a GitHub marketplace's local copy when the fetch failed and the marketplace was named after its repository
- Fixed plugin and marketplace messages, logs and `claude plugin marketplace list` showing a password or token stored in a git, ssh or marketplace URL
- Fixed a resumed cloud session leaving an unanswered question open in the transcript after a queued message superseded it
- Fixed vim mode placing the cursor one character right after a dot-repeated "!" or a fast-typed "i!" switched a non-empty prompt into shell mode
- Fixed fullscreen mode freezing or blanking for several seconds when scrolling up past a large file diff
- Fixed a stray `</ccmemory>`-style closing tag occasionally appearing in responses
- Fixed plugin messages, logs and the VS Code plugin dialog showing the wrong server for some git addresses
- Fixed a terminal `API Error: 400` on every turn for users behind a network gateway that rewrites API error responses when a beta request header is rejected
- Fixed sandboxed Bash commands on Linux reporting exit code 0 for failed commands when the shell is zsh
- Fixed the Read tool hanging instead of reporting an error when part of a large file could not be decoded under memory pressure
- Fixed `--resume`, the resume picker preview, resumed background agents and the transcript view failing on a session whose saved history contains a malformed task-reminder or @-file attachment entry
- Fixed a crash when resuming a conversation whose transcript contains a malformed message entry, and a fullscreen crash when such a conversation received new messages while scrolled up
- Fixed sessions failing to resume or start when their saved transcript contains a malformed message content block
- Fixed Grep, Glob and @-file suggestions hanging or running out of memory on searches over the 20MB output cap, and system ripgrep reporting "no matches" instead of an error after a flood of warnings
- Fixed `/rewind` in a forked or background session restoring a zero-filled or truncated file when the session's file-history backups could not be fully copied
- Fixed fullscreen sessions sometimes exiting with "Claude Code exited after an unrecoverable interface error" when typing fast or holding a key with the slash-command dropdown open
- Fixed background sessions crashing and restarting their worker when a command fed through stdin ran on a machine that had run out of file descriptors
- Fixed a crash at launch when `~/.claude.json` holds a malformed `mcpNeedsAuthNoticed` value
- Fixed `--resume` and `--continue` dropping a conversation's earlier thinking when a built-in tool it started with has since been switched off by a server-side flag
- Fixed text selected with the mouse in the fullscreen `claude --resume` session picker never reaching the clipboard
- Fixed plugin reload previews replacing a running session's extracted plugin files when the plugin was loaded from a `--plugin-dir` or `--plugin-url` archive
- Fixed self-hosted runners with `--drain-wait-sec` losing the final result of a turn that finished during a SIGTERM drain; the runner now waits briefly for the turn to be reported
- Fixed `SubagentStop` hooks with a specific `matcher` firing for every stopping subagent whose agent type was empty
- Fixed sandboxed Bash commands being unable to write to project directories named `hooks/` or `config/`
- Fixed Artifact updates failing with "File not found" after a session resumes on another machine or its scratchpad is cleared: the page's last published version is restored
- Fixed `/update-config` writing `Write(path)` permission rules, which file permission checks don't match, instead of `Edit(path)` rules
- Fixed four dead documentation URLs (Pricing, Computer Use, Skills, CLI) in the bundled claude-api skill's live-sources table
- Improved prompt caching for a `--system-prompt` that contains a `__SYSTEM_PROMPT_DYNAMIC_BOUNDARY__` line: the text above it is now cached globally, as the SDK's array form already is
- Improved the `/desktop` error when Claude Desktop does not open: it now says why and what to do next
- Improved the Artifact tool's publish and read results: they now say who can open the page and what the owner's Share menu offers
- Improved artifact publish results: they name the tab icon sent, warn when the page contains a NUL byte, and retry a flaky fetch of the newer page to merge after a stale publish
- Improved pasted and attached images: they are now saved where Claude can open them as files without a permission prompt, including in Desktop and VS Code
- Improved the Artifact tool's guidance so Claude updates a shared artifact in place when you were given edit access to it, instead of publishing a separate copy
- Improved plan-usage reads: editor windows and non-interactive sessions on one machine now share a read made in the last minute instead of each calling the usage endpoint
- Improved the `ListPlugins` tool description so Claude knows it lists plugins enabled on your claude.ai account, not plugins installed locally with `/plugin`
- Improved responsiveness when the terminal is slow or paused: output no longer falls further behind while the terminal catches up
- Improved Write and Edit results for files in the synced account-skills folder: they now say the change is not saved to your account and how to save it
- Updated `/logout` for Claude apps gateway sign-ins to also end the session on gateways that advertise token revocation
- Changed hosted sessions to keep an unanswered permission prompt up after a container restart, instead of asking again
- Changed the Artifact tool to ask for a one-word tab icon on a first publish instead of an emoji favicon
- Changed Claude in Chrome in auto mode to skip the extension's per-site check for classifier-approved calls, as bypass mode does, fixing `browser_batch` "Permission denied" after a redirect
- Changed plugins installed from an npm source to be fetched with `npm pack --ignore-scripts` and integrity-verified, so a package's install scripts no longer run
- Changed scheduled and Run now routine runs to save data to, and republish the page of, an artifact you can edit without asking; public artifacts, first publishes and deletes still ask
- Removed the startup notice that told you a one-off scheduled routine had run since your last session
- [VSCode] Added viewing, editing and deleting a saved memory inside the Memory dialog
- [VSCode] Added sending an attached image without typing any text
- [VSCode] Added a Retry link to the MCP servers dialog when the server list fails to load
- [VSCode] Added accept and reject buttons under each change in the proposed-change diff tab, so an edit can be reviewed change by change
- [VSCode] Fixed the transcript creeping toward the bottom in small steps while a permission card waits and content keeps arriving
- [VSCode] Fixed rewound and forked conversations not keeping the permission mode you had picked for the original conversation
- [VSCode] Fixed an empty `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` entry in the `environmentVariables` setting making Claude Code keep its files in the workspace
- [VSCode] Fixed plugin install links opening the Manage plugins dialog for plugin names and marketplace addresses that can't be used in a link
- [VSCode] Fixed Remote Control staying shown as connected after a turn-off that Claude Code reported as failed; it now shows as off
- [VSCode] Fixed the scroll to the bottom on send stopping short of the reply when the reply starts arriving during the scroll
- [VSCode] Fixed the agent map showing agents a crash left unfinished as stopped instead of failed once the session is reopened
- [VSCode] Fixed the "Continuing the step" notice not appearing, and the continue limit resetting, after a reload that follows a crash with background tasks still running
- [VSCode] Fixed the session list showing when a session was last reopened, such as after a window reload, instead of when its last message was sent
- [VSCode] Fixed "Fork conversation from here" failing on the message right after one sent while Claude was working
- [VSCode] Fixed the prompt cache clock showing too few minutes after reopening a session with a message sent while Claude was working
- [VSCode] Fixed a background agent that finished while Claude was running a tool losing its completion notice, and its result on the agent map, after a window reload
- [VSCode] Fixed a rare case where text selected in a git-ignored file could be sent to Claude after the extension was unresponsive for several seconds
- [VSCode] Fixed renaming a running session reverting to the generated name (regression in 2.1.269)
- [VSCode] Fixed some claude.ai/code sessions opening in VS Code as an empty conversation with no messages
- [VSCode] Fixed slash commands typed while Claude is responding being sent to the model as text instead of running once the response finishes
- [VSCode] Fixed unreadable code in the plan preview and the Hooks and Permission rules dialogs with the High Contrast Light theme
- [VSCode] Fixed `/remote-control` being ignored while Remote Control is still connecting: running it again now turns Remote Control off immediately
- [VSCode] Fixed the conversation pulling you back to the bottom while a reply streams after you scroll up, and added a `claudeCode.scrollToBottomOnSend` setting to turn off the jump on send
- [VSCode] Fixed the Manage plugins dialog showing a password or token that was typed into a marketplace URL
- [VSCode] Improved the agent map: the pill counts running agents and turns red after a failure, the main agent stays in view while the map scrolls, and agents sort by state then end time
- [VSCode] Changed New session in a Claude editor tab to open in the sidebar when Preferred Location is set to Sidebar, instead of always opening another tab
- [VSCode] Changed a message sent while Claude is working to wait at the bottom of the conversation until Claude starts on it
- [Claude Code on the web] Added a "New routine" button to the page shown when a routine link no longer resolves, next to the link back to your routines list
- [Claude Code on the web] Fixed routine "paused" and "on hold" notifications being cut off mid-sentence; the paused-subscription notice now says to turn the routine back on yourself
- [Claude Code on the web] Fixed cloud environments with a very long allowed-domains list saving fine and then failing every session start; saving now fails up front and says how much to trim
- [Claude Code on the web] Fixed Claude's guidance when a cloud session on a personal account is denied GitHub access: it now links to claude.ai/connect-github instead of an admin settings page
- [Claude Code on the web] Improved what Claude tells you when asked to edit, delete or run a routine it didn't create: it now links to the routine's page so you can do it yourself
- [Claude Tag] Added attach conditions for access bundles in Claude Tag settings: an Owner can let a bundle also apply in channels with guests or Slack Connect channels, not just member-only
- [Claude Tag] Added Amazon CloudWatch, CloudWatch Logs, Amazon SNS, Google Cloud Monitoring and Cloud Logging presets to an access bundle's Credentials tab in Claude Tag admin settings
- [Claude Tag] Added Datadog presets for the US3, AP1, AP2 and US1-FED sites; new Datadog connections are now limited to Datadog's read and query API routes
- [Claude Tag] Fixed S3 uploads from recent AWS CLI and SDK versions failing with a 502 error when sent through an AWS connection
- [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude treating a channel as inactive, and skipping untagged messages there, while it was still posting in that channel from a routine or a thread
- [Claude Tag] Fixed a thread's "Claude [task]" display name reverting to plain "Claude" after the session behind that thread was refreshed or restarted
- [Claude Tag] Fixed the model you switched to in a Slack thread silently reverting to the channel's default after that thread's session was restarted or refreshed
- [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude sometimes replying twice when another app or bot @mentioned it in a top-level channel message
- [Claude Tag] Improved Claude's notices in Enterprise Grid channels shared across workspaces: they now say when no workspace is set up yet, or why only organization defaults apply
- [Code Review] Fixed reviews occasionally dropping part of their analysis when one of the reviewing agents returned its findings in an unexpected format
- [Code Review] Fixed pull requests with more than 100 Claude reviews getting a full re-review on every clean merge from the base branch instead of the lighter merge-focused review

key_changes: 新增发送快捷键（Ctrl+Enter 或 Ctrl+X Ctrl+S），可中断当前轮次并立即发送所有排队消息
新增 Claude Apps 网关登录账户确认功能，凭据保存前需用户确认，/status 中显示账户信息
新增 claude.ai 账户技能和插件同步到终端会话的功能，可通过配置项选择关闭
新增 /plugin install 命令支持 --marketplace 参数，可先添加市场再安装插件
npm 来源的插件安装改为使用 npm pack --ignore-scripts 并验证完整性，不再执行安装脚本
ai_summary.summary_cn: 本版本为 Claude Code 引入了多项新功能，包括快捷发送消息、Claude 账户技能/插件同步、增强的插件安装机制以及更安全的 npm 插件安装方式。同时修复了大量问题，涵盖消息流、完整屏模式、会话恢复、VS Code 扩展、Claude Tag 和 Code Review 等多个方面，显著提升了整体稳定性和用户体验。

releases.author: ashwin-ant
releases.summary:
## What's changed

- Added a visible warning when memory usage is critical, with steps to free memory or restart safely
- Added `CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_STARTUP_WAIT_MS` to bound how long the first non-interactive turn waits for connecting MCP servers (`0` = don't wait)
- Added `effort` attribute to the `claude_code.llm_request` OpenTelemetry trace span, matching the `api_request` event
- Added `claude_code.managed_settings_resolved` OTel event: managed-settings sources and policy helper state; redacted settings and digests with `OTEL_LOG_MANAGED_SETTINGS=1`
- Added `store.connect_timeout_seconds` to the Claude apps gateway config to lengthen the Postgres connect timeout (default 5 seconds), and improved the boot error when the database is unreachable to point to `store.postgres_url` and the configured timeout
- Added `enduser.sub`, the IdP subject, to the telemetry Claude Desktop and Cowork send through a Claude apps gateway
- Added a Claude apps gateway warning when a replica has more requests open than the 256 it sends upstream at once, and a startup log line showing that limit
- Added click-to-expand for collapsed teammate and agent messages in fullscreen mode
- Fixed sessions getting stuck endlessly retrying "unexpected tool_use_id" 400 errors: corrupted transcripts now self-heal where possible, and otherwise a clear error (with a `/rewind` hint) ends the loop
- Fixed MCP servers configured as `http` that only speak legacy HTTP+SSE failing to connect when they answer the first request with 422 or another 4xx error
- Fixed Streamable HTTP MCP tool calls timing out after about 5 minutes even when a longer per-server `timeout` was set
- Fixed MCP prompts and resources not refreshing when a server sends list-changed notifications without declaring `listChanged`
- Fixed MCP tool calls refused with 403 insufficient_scope being reported as an expired sign-in: the error now names the missing permissions and points to `/mcp` re-authentication
- Fixed hook-driven sessions (such as an active `/goal`) ending with "Prompt is too long" instead of compacting when the context overflowed again after a reactive compaction
- Fixed an active `/goal` being lost when resuming (`--continue` / `--resume`) a session that had compacted

releases.summary:
- Cline can now work on a remote machine over SSH, with the app itself staying local. Add and test a host under **Settings → Remote**, then pick it from the environment selector beside the workspace picker on the welcome screen — saving or testing a profile does not activate it. The connection opens at the remote user's home directory; **Add project…** in the workspace picker browses that machine for a project, and **Local** disconnects. Agent tools, workspace discovery, Git metadata, and session persistence all run on the host while approvals and live session events return to the desktop, because only the authenticated Cline Hub protocol is forwarded through the tunnel. SSH config aliases work: leave **Port** blank to use the alias's own configuration, or enter one to override it. Recent and last-used workspaces are remembered separately per host. Host metadata lives at `~/.cline/data/settings/remote-environments.json` (mode `0600`) and records an identity-file path, never private-key contents; the host key must already be trusted by your SSH client, and unknown or changed keys are rejected. On first connect Cline uploads a self-contained helper to `~/.cline/remote/` — no `apt`, `npm`, root access, global CLI install, or public port — and caches it for faster reconnects, leaving any existing Cline CLI hub on that account running. Linux x64 and arm64 hosts are supported (32-bit Raspberry Pi operating systems are not; macOS hosts need a locally built helper via `CLINE_REMOTE_HELPER_BINARY`). File attachments and opening a remote file in a local editor are not available in remote sessions yet — text, images, file mentions and search, Git branch operations, session history, and remote agent tools are
- Sub-agents spawned in the same step now run at the same time instead of one after another, so delegating three independent pieces of work takes as long as the slowest one rather than the sum of all three. Tools that must run in order still do, and only back-to-back parallel calls overlap

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cline/cline/compare/desktop-v0.0.30...desktop-v0.0.31

key_changes: 新增 SSH 远程工作模式：应用保持本地运行，可通过 SSH 在远程机器上工作，支持在设置中添加和测试远程主机
同一步骤中生成的多个子代理现在可并行运行，而非串行执行，显著提升多任务委托效率
远程连接支持 SSH 配置别名、按主机分别记忆最近工作区、远程环境元数据以安全模式（0600）存储在本地
首次连接时自动上传自包含辅助程序至远程机器的 ~/.cline/remote/，支持 Linux x64/arm64 主机并缓存以加速重连
远程会话暂不支持文件附件和本地编辑器打开远程文件（后续版本补充）
ai_summary.summary_cn: Cline 桌面版 v0.0.31 引入了全新的 SSH 远程工作能力，用户可以在应用保持本地运行的同时，通过 SSH 在远程机器上执行代理工具、工作区发现、Git 操作和会话持久化等全部功能，并通过安全的 Cline Hub 协议隧道转发认证信息。同时，同一步骤中的多个子代理现在支持并行执行，大幅提升多任务委托的并发效率。远程模式目前限支持 Linux x64/arm64 主机，且文件附件和本地编辑远程文件等功能尚不可用。

releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.summary:
### Added

- Images attached to a model that cannot read them are now flagged instead of silently discarded. Thumbnails get a warning badge and the composer explains that the images will be ignored, with a button to switch to an image-capable model. Previously the thumbnail looked normal and the image was replaced with a text placeholder just before the request, so there was no way to tell it had been dropped. Model info and the attachment picker also report image support accurately for models that declare text-only input without listing capabilities.

### Changed

- Cline's logo and icons have been refreshed throughout the extension, including the activity bar and panel icons.
- The W&B Inference provider is now listed as CoreWeave, with its sign-up and API-key links updated to match CoreWeave's current documentation.

### Fixed

- Long tasks now compact when they actually need to rather than running out of room. The trigger compared a character-based estimate of the conversation (~3 characters per token) against the model's context limit, so content that tokenizes far denser than that — disassembly, image dumps, minified sources — could fill the real context window while the estimate stayed under the threshold and compaction never fired; the turn was then squeezed down to a handful of output tokens. The trigger now also uses the token count the provider itself reports, and how much history is kept is scaled by how far off the estimate turned out to be. The summarizer's output budget also doubled, so a model that reasons before answering can no longer spend the whole budget thinking and return no summary at all.
- On Windows, opening a repository that contains a file named `rg.exe`, `git.exe`, or `powershell.exe` no longer runs that file in place of the real program. Bare program names were resolved through the workspace directory before PATH, so a planted executable ran with your privileges as soon as the workspace was indexed. Cline now sets Windows' `NoDefaultCurrentDirectoryInExePath` opt-out at startup, in both the VS Code extension and the JetBrains core. Processes Cline launches inherit it, so inside a Command Prompt shell a program in the current directory now needs `.\` as it already does in PowerShell.
- A model turn that fails mid-stream with a transient provider error is now retried up to three times with backoff instead of ending the task. A single rate-limit response forwarded by a gateway previously surfaced as a failed task. A turn that has already streamed output is never retried, so nothing is duplicated.
- Terminal commands that succeed without printing anything (`git add -A` on a clean tree, for example) are now reported as empty output. They were treated as a shell-integration failure, which fed the model a snapshot of unrelated terminal scrollback prefixed with a warning that the output could not be captured, so silent commands intermittently looked like failures.
- Checkpoints no longer re-hash every untracked file on each message. In workspaces holding large untracked directories this delayed every message by seconds to minutes; a persistent per-task index now lets git skip files it has already seen.
- `run_commands` no longer hangs until its timeout after a command that backgrounds a child process. The command had finished, but the backgrounded process held the output pipes open.
- `apply_patch` no longer silently overwrites an existing file when the model uses "Add File" on a path that already exists. The file's contents were replaced with no error and no record of what was lost.
- PowerShell commands the model wrapped in another `powershell -Command "..."` are no longer parsed twice. The outer shell consumed `$_` before the inner command ran, so pipelines using it emitted an error for every item processed while still reporting success.
- Opening your home directory as a workspace no longer drives the extension host to exhaustion. Typing an `@` mention indexed every file beneath it and re-ranked the whole index on each keystroke.
- The "Supports Images" checkbox in OpenAI Compatible model settings now stays where you put it. The checkbox rendered the last committed value, and the re-sync that arrived during the save round-trip was re-emitted as a change event that wrote the old value back over your edit.
- The error shown to the model when an `editor` call omits the text to replace now names the file and explains how to recover. The previous message was terse enough that some models re-sent the identical call until the task stopped.
- Credentials are now stripped of invisible characters when saved, not only when pasted, and the cleanup covers AWS, GCP, and SAP fields and custom header values in addition to API keys.
- Cline Pass now defaults to a model from your subscription rather than a free one. Its model list contains both tiers and the default was whichever model was published most recently, so a subscriber who never picked a model could be left on the free tier.
- Cline Pass and free models now show no cost rather than the underlying market price, which is not what you are billed for.
- Model pickers now fall back to the full Recommended, Free, and Subscribed lists when the models endpoint cannot be reached. The offline fallback was a short hardcoded list with no subscription tier at all.
- Model lists for providers sharing the built-in catalog now refresh from the live catalog, so newly published models appear without an extension update, with timeouts so an unresponsive provider endpoint cannot stall the list.
- Claude Code and OpenCode no longer ask for an API key they never read. Both authenticate from their own local CLI's credentials, but they were treated as key-based providers; the workaround was storing a dummy key. A missing CLI on `PATH` now warns rather than blocking, since a configured path or bundled binary also works.
- The OpenAI Codex (ChatGPT subscription) model list no longer offers models the backend rejects, and Codex context limits are applied to every Codex model instead of being inherited from the OpenAI API catalog, which inflated both the context budget and the usage figures derived from it.
- Models served by OpenCode Go are now sent over the wire protocol each one actually speaks. Every model was sent over the OpenAI chat-completions adapter, so models on that endpoint speaking other protocols failed or misbehaved.
- Task history no longer goes blank when a task spawns many subagents. Subagent rows crowded out the tasks that created them, hiding the parent task and everything older.
- Langfuse tracing, when configured, is now limited to the Cline and Cline Pass providers. The provider was ignored, so prompts and responses sent to third-party and bring-your-own-key providers were exported too.

### Changed

- Web search is now enabled by default on models that support it, outside YOLO mode. It can still be turned off in settings, and a settings file that cannot be read leaves it disabled rather than silently on.
- The `run_commands` tool description now names the PowerShell edition in use — `Windows PowerShell (powershell.exe)` versus `PowerShell (pwsh.exe)` — quotes its guidance against that executable, and tells the model to run commands directly rather than wrapping them in another shell invocation. It also no longer describes the environment as Windows when `pwsh` is the configured shell on macOS or Linux.
- Refreshed the built-in model catalog. Adds four providers (Infer by Flow7, Melious, NaN, and Wallaby) and takes the catalog from 5,788 to 6,079 models. This is a wide refresh: the resolved default model changes for 44 providers, most of them landing on DeepSeek V4.1 Flash — among them Hugging Face, Fireworks, Requesty, Nebius, Cortecs, CrossModel, DigitalOcean, Eden AI, and OpenCode Go. Gemini and Vertex now resolve to Gemini 3.8 Flash, GitHub Copilot and Vivgrid to GPT-6 Astra, and NVIDIA to GLM 5.3 Flash. If you use a provider without pinning a model, expect a different default.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cline/cline/compare/v4.1.18...v4.1.19

releases.summary:
- Windows updates no longer fail with "Error opening file for writing". The installer hook meant to stop the running backend never terminated anything: Tauri ships a 32-bit NSIS installer, so its PowerShell ran under WOW64, where `Get-Process` reports an empty path for every 64-bit process — the filter matched no sidecar on any x64 machine. The installer then wrote over an executable the detached Hub daemon still held open, which is why updating from 0.0.25 through 0.0.28 failed exactly as 0.0.24 did. The installer now asks the Windows Restart Manager which processes hold this install's files and shuts those down; that is bitness-independent, covers the connector processes the Hub spawns, and leaves a side-by-side Cline Beta alone. If Restart Manager itself fails you get a Retry/Cancel prompt rather than a half-replaced install
- On Windows, Cline no longer runs a program out of your workspace when it means to run the system one. Windows resolves a bare program name through the child process's working directory before it searches PATH, and Cline runs `rg`, `git`, and `powershell` with your workspace as that directory — so a repository that happened to contain its own `rg.exe` would have that copy executed as soon as the workspace was indexed. Cline now opts out of current-directory executable search at startup, and every process it spawns inherits the setting
- Long sessions now compact when they actually need to rather than running out of room. The trigger compared a character-based estimate of the transcript (~3 characters per token) against the model's context limit, so content that tokenizes far denser than that — disassembly, image dumps, minified sources — could fill the real context window while the estimate stayed under the threshold and compaction never fired; the turn was then squeezed down to a handful of output tokens. The trigger now also uses the token count the provider itself reports, and how much history is kept is scaled by how far off the estimate turned out to be. The summarizer's output budget also doubled, so a model that reasons before answering can no longer spend the whole budget thinking and return no summary at all
- A tool that streams its output no longer keeps spinning after it has finished. When a tool streamed everything as it went, its completion event carried no final output, which chat read as "still running" — so the tool kept its running presentation, spinner included, for the rest of the turn
- Refreshed Cline's logo and app icons throughout the app, the Dock and taskbar, and the installer
- The CoreWeave provider's branding and setup links now match CoreWeave's current documentation, and Weights & Biases gained a direct link to its API key page from provider setup

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cline/cline/compare/desktop-v0.0.29...desktop-v0.0.30

改进长会话压缩机制：基于实际 token 数触发压缩，并扩大总结输出预算
修复流式输出工具完成后仍显示运行状态（转圈）的问题
更新 Cline 应用图标、CoreWeave 品牌信息及 W&B API Key 页链接

## New Features

- Added experimental `/voice` conversations with live transcripts and microphone controls on supported builds, enabled through `/experimental`. (#43581, #43651, #44331)
- The TUI now shows live reasoning summaries in the status row and completion timestamps after successful turns. (#43558, #43921)

- Amazon Bedrock can now obtain AWS credentials from configured commands, with caching, expiration-based refresh, and authentication recovery. (#44028)

- Accepted prompts are now saved even when compaction fails before a turn starts. (#44487)

- Blocked Windows-process escapes from restricted WSL sandboxes and hardened brokered shell snapshots against credential exposure. (#44286, #43909, #44040)

releases.author: ruvnet
releases.summary:
## What changed

Fixes Finding B of #3327: `memory_search({ smart: true })` was reporting SmartRetrieval's internal RRF fusion score in the `similarity` field instead of the underlying retrieval relevance score — e.g. a raw retrieval relevance of `0.8` was showing up as `0.03252247488101534`.

- `similarity` now carries the raw retrieval relevance (matches `smart: false` behavior)
- the fused SmartRetrieval ranking score is now exposed separately as `rankingScore`
- `threshold` behavior is unchanged (still applied pre-RRF/MMR/recency)
- 14 new regression tests across the SmartRetrieval package and MCP handler

Fixed in #3340 (thanks @takagibit18).

Finding A of #3327 (reasoningBank/vectorBackend reporting `enabled:true` but routing through `bridge-fallback`) remains open and unclaimed.

## Note on version history

3.42.1–3.42.3 were published to npm without matching version-bump commits on `main`. Verified their tags (`v3.42.0`, `v3.42.1`, `v3.42.3`) are all ancestors of this release, so 3.42.4 is a strict superset of everything previously shipped.

Co-Authored-By: RuFlo <ruv@ruv.net>

key_changes: 修复 memory_search({ smart: true }) 中 similarity 字段错误展示 SmartRetrieval RRF 融合分数的问题，现在改为返回底层检索相关性分数（如 0.05432 恢复正常显示为 0.8）
新增 rankingScore 字段，单独暴露 SmartRetrieval 融合排序分数
相似度阈值（threshold）行为保持不变，仍应用于 RRF/MMR/recency 处理之前
新增 14 个回归测试，覆盖 SmartRetrieval 包和 MCP 处理器
确认 3.42.4 版本是此前所有已发布版本（3.42.0-3.42.3）的严格超集，修复了版本号与提交不同步的问题
ai_summary.summary_cn: 此版本修复了 memory_search({ smart: true }) 模式下的一个字段语义错误：similarity 字段此前错误地返回 SmartRetrieval 内部的 RRF 融合分数（例如原始相关性 0.8 显示为 0.0325），现已改为返回底层检索相关性分数，与此前 smart: false 的行为保持一致；融合排序分数则通过新增的 rankingScore 字段单独暴露。同时新增 14 个回归测试覆盖此修复，并验证 3.42.4 是此前所有发布版本的严格超集。

releases.author: vincentkoc
releases.summary:
**Highlights:** Applications and CLI processes can share sessions through one local queue owner and watch session activity with cursor replay. Embedding hosts can guard session controls with optional authority checks. Direct session-journal consumers must distinguish local records from ACP messages.

### Changes

- Runtime/shared sessions: add `createSharedAcpRuntime()` so applications and CLI processes share one local queue owner, with targeted turn cancellation and explicit submission uncertainty. Thanks @mavam.
- Sessions/watching: add passive `sessions watch` and shared-runtime `watchSession()` with cursor replay, request IDs, and settled turn outcomes. Thanks @mavam.

### Breaking

- Session journals: `.stream.ndjson` now includes local lifecycle and segment records alongside ACP messages; direct consumers must distinguish entries with `jsonrpc: "2.0"`. Built-in readers and portable ACP archives filter local records.

### Fixes

- Runtime/session controls: check optional host authority before sending mode, model, and configuration changes, including reconnect replay; preserve accepted replies and saved selections when authority is later revoked.

### Verification

- [npm acpx 0.17.0](https://www.npmjs.com/package/acpx/v/0.17.0), [successful Release workflow](https://github.com/openclaw/acpx/actions/runs/35202284284), [main CI](https://github.com/openclaw/acpx/actions/runs/35201829544), and [CodeQL](https://github.com/openclaw/acpx/actions/runs/35201349360).
- Clean npm-installed CLI/runtime smoke passed: shared runtime and external CLI turns, owner continuity, watch replay, cursor resume, settled results, and peer cleanup.
- Package integrity and provenance match the released source. `npm audit signatures` verified registry signatures for 41 packages and attestations for 18 packages.

[Release PR](https://github.com/openclaw/acpx/pull/617) · [Full changelog](https://github.com/openclaw/acpx/compare/v0.16.0...v0.17.0)

key_changes: 新增共享运行时（createSharedAcpRuntime()），使应用程序和 CLI 进程共享同一本地队列所有者，支持定向取消和提交不确定性确认
新增被动会话监视功能 sessions watch 及 watchSession()，支持游标回放、请求 ID 和已结算轮次结果
会话日志格式变更（Breaking）：.stream.ndjson 现包含本地生命周期和段记录，直接消费者需通过 jsonrpc: 2.0 字段区分本地记录与 ACP 消息
运行时/会话控制新增可选宿主权限检查，防止未经授权的模式、模型和配置变更，即使权限被撤销也会保留已接受的回复和所选配置
ai_summary.summary_cn: acpx v0.17.0 引入了共享运行时与会话监视功能，使多进程之间可以共享会话并实时观察活动。然而，这是一个包含 Breaking Changes 的版本——会话日志格式发生变化，直接消费 .stream.ndjson 的应用程序需要区分本地记录与 ACP 消息。此外，新增了可选的宿主权限控制，增强了会话管理的安全性。

key_changes: vercel.kms 多个方法的响应中移除了 edDsa 算法的枚举支持，包括 createKmsIssuer、listKmsIssuers、updateKmsIssuer、getKmsIssuer、revokeKmsSigningKey
vercel.checksV2 多个方法（如 listDeploymentCheckRuns、createDeploymentCheckRun 等）的响应中新增了 source.union(5) 选项
vercel.user 的 listUserEvents() 和 listEventTypes() 方法响应中的 events[] 和 types[] 字段发生了变化
vercel.deployments.createDeployment() 新增了请求中的 buildMachine 参数
多个 projects 相关方法（如 getProjects、createProject、getProject 等）的响应中 permissions 字段发生了变更
ai_summary.summary_cn: 本次 v1.28.35 版本包含多项 Breaking Changes，主要集中在 KMS 服务中移除 edDsa 算法枚举支持，以及 ChecksV2 系列接口新增 source 联合类型选项。此外，Projects 相关接口的 permissions 字段、User 事件接口返回结构，以及 Deployments 创建接口的请求参数也均有调整，建议调用方关注并适配这些变更。

changes.description: Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry 及禁用遥测的安装默认使用 v2 MCP 客户端和 MCP 2026-07-28 协议协商，与直接 HTTP 服务器通信（可通过 MCP_SDK_GENERATION=v1 或 MCP_PROTOCOL_NEGOTIATION=legacy 选择旧版）
.mcp.json、设置、插件和代理文件中 type 为 sdk 的 MCP 条目将被跳过并显示警告，只有 SDK 宿主应用才能注册进程内服务器
插件和市场克隆不再下载 Git LFS 文件，仅保留指针，需在检出目录中手动执行 git lfs pull 获取
本地会话中的工件监听行为变更：在其他位置发布的新版本不再自动触发新一轮对话，Claude 将在后续工件工具结果中获知
排队的后台任务完成现在共享一次模型调用：每个任务仍获得自己的 result，但除最后一个外其余 result 均为空，且 num_turns 为 0
Web 搜索现在默认在支持该功能的模型上启用（YOLO 模式除外），可通过设置关闭
内置模型目录大规模刷新：44 个提供商的默认模型发生变更（多数切换至 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash，Gemini 切换至 3.8 Flash 等），未固定模型的用户将获得不同的默认模型
Cline Pass 默认使用订阅中的模型而非免费模型，订阅者若从未选择模型将不再停留在免费层
Cline Pass 和免费模型现在显示零成本而非底层市场价格
Langfuse 追踪现在仅限 Cline 和 Cline Pass 提供商，不再导出第三方和自带密钥提供商的提示和响应
新增 SSH 远程工作能力：主机元数据存储在 ~/.cline/data/settings/remote-environments.json（权限 0600），仅记录身份文件路径而非私钥内容；远程会话暂不支持文件附件和在本地编辑器中打开远程文件
新增托管 Responses WebSocket 会话 API
新增提示缓存预热功能
会话日志 .stream.ndjson 现在包含本地生命周期和分段记录以及 ACP 消息，直接消费者必须通过 jsonrpc: "2.0" 区分条目；内置读取器和便携式 ACP 归档会自动过滤本地记录
KMS 相关 API（createKmsIssuer、listKmsIssuers、updateKmsIssuer、getKmsIssuer、revokeKmsSigningKey）的响应中 algorithm 枚举值 edDsa 被移除
checksV2 相关 API（listDeploymentCheckRuns、createDeploymentCheckRun、getDeploymentCheckRun、updateDeploymentCheckRun、listCheckRuns）的响应中 source 联合类型新增 union(5) 枚举值
user.listUserEvents 的 response.events[] 和 user.listEventTypes 的 response.types[] 类型发生变更
多个项目相关 API（getProjects、createProject、getProject、updateProject、uploadProjectAvatar、updateMicrofrontends）的 response.permissions 类型发生变更
deployments.createDeployment 的请求体新增 buildMachine 字段
checksV2.updateProjectCheck 的请求体 requires 枚举新增 none 值
sandboxes.getNamedSandbox 错误响应新增 502 状态码
memory_search({ smart: true }) 的 similarity 字段现在返回原始检索相关性分数（与 smart: false 一致），而非 SmartRetrieval 内部的 RRF 融合分数；融合排名分数现在通过新的 rankingScore 字段单独暴露

issue_insights.summary_brief: 今日跨仓库共性问题高度集中，主要体现在三个方向：依赖/打包与运行环境不兼容导致的启动即崩溃（涉及 aider、tabby、ClawX 等），工作流运行时（workflow_runtime）中的静默失败、数据丢失与状态错乱（涉及 agentscope、agno、anthropics 系、skills、claude-plugins），以及认证/权限（auth_permission）层面的安全绕过与凭据泄露（涉及 agno、claude-code-action、AutoGPT）。其中"磁盘空间不足导致版本检查写缓存抛未捕获 OSError 阻断启动"波及最多达 43 个仓库，是最广泛的跨仓共性问题。
global_highlights: 磁盘/IO 异常未优雅降级成为最广泛共性问题：43 个仓库共用同一信号，非关键版本检查等辅助操作抛未捕获 OSError 即可阻断整个应用启动，说明业界普遍缺乏对运行时 IO 故障的容错与降级设计。
依赖版本不同步/运行环境不兼容致启动崩毁（packaging_release）是第二大簇：aider 因 litellm 新增异常类未同步、yarl 缺 propcache 模块、scipy 原生模块装载失败而崩溃，tabby 因注册表 JSON 反序列化失败崩溃，波及 9 个仓库，反映 AI 工具链上游依赖变动是持续痛点。
静默失败已成为头号质量隐患：多仓报告工具'看起来成功/报成功'但实际丢数据——AutoGPT 数据块静默置空、agentscope RAG 解析器静默丢文档、claude-plugins 安全审查伪造 CRITICAL 引用、skills 评测工具全技能误报 0% recall、phoenix 多副本摄入静默丢 span，凡此种种让用户无从察觉、无从定位。

认证/权限与凭据安全是高风险子簇：agno CodingTools.run_shell 沙箱可被 chr() 编码/inline flag 绕过实现 RCE（CVSS 9.8）、claude-code-action 将安装 token 写入 .git/config 且硬编码 base URL 绕过代理、stagehand 网络域策略被 service-worker/WebSocket 绕过，三者均构成真实的安全边界失效。

top_pain_points.topic: 因依赖/运行环境不兼容（litellm 新增异常类未同步进 aider 的 exceptions 列表、缺少 propcache 模块），aider 启动即未捕获崩溃
top_pain_points.summary: 两个不同根因的启动崩溃：aider 0.86.2 调用 litellm 时因 litellm 新增的 PermissionDeniedError 不在 aider.exceptions 列表中而 ValueError 崩溃；另一用户因 yarl 依赖的 propcache.api 模块缺失导致 ModuleNotFoundError 崩溃。均在启动/初始化阶段未捕获异常，工具无法运行。
top_pain_points.review_reason: 这两类都是依赖版本漂移/打包不完整导致 aider 在启动阶段未捕获崩溃、用户完全无法运行的核心问题。litellm 异常清单不同步会随主流依赖更新影响大量用户，propcache 缺失直接影响启动。虽为两个不同根因，但共同构成'依赖不兼容阻断启动'这一可感知痛点。

source_issues.title: Uncaught ValueError in exceptions.py line 71
source_issues.evidence: macOS 上 aider 0.86.2 运行时在 send_message 内 LiteLLMExceptions().__init__ 抛 ValueError('PermissionDeniedError is in litellm but not in aider's exceptions list')，说明 litellm 升级后新增异常类与 aider 硬编码的异常清单不同步，启动/运行即崩。

source_issues.title: Uncaught ModuleNotFoundError in _url.py line 22
source_issues.evidence: Windows 10 上启动时 litellm 懒加载进而 yarl _url 导入 'from propcache.api import under_cached_property' 失败，ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'propcache.api'，在 models.validate_environment 阶段崩溃，未捕获。

source_issues.title: Uncaught ImportError in _svdp.py line 23
source_issues.evidence: 两个用户完全相同 traceback：get_repo_messages->get_repo_map->get_ranked_tags->nx.pagerank->to_scipy_sparse_array->scipy.sparse.linalg._svdp->_propack._spropack dlopen 失败。分属 pipx(python 3.12.8) 与 uv(python 3.12.7) 安装的 macOS arm64 环境，均因同一 .so 加载错误崩溃。

source_issues.title: Uncaught ImportError in _svdp.py line 23
source_issues.evidence: 同根因、同 traceback，分属 .local/pipx 与 .local/share/uv 两个安装路径，均报 _spropack.cpython-312-darwin.so 的 __DATA/__thread_bss zero-fill 段 offset 错误。

source_issues.title: autogen-ext: mcp 2.0.0 breaks MCP tools (no upper bound, uses removed/renamed 1.x APIs)
source_issues.evidence: mcp=['mcp>=1.11.0'] 无上界,2026-07-28 发布 mcp 2.0.0;逐项列出受影响代码:streamablehttp_client 改名、3-tuple 变 2-tuple 并移除 timeout kwargs、ClientSession 改 float、camelCase 改 snake_case,inputSchema/isError 等;当前是 live 潜在缺陷。

source_issues.title: playwright install fails to fetch files on a machine with IPv4 and internet-inaccessible IPv6
source_issues.evidence: IPv4 正常、IPv6 无外网时 install 下载 5 次各自超时后失败，而同一 URL 用 curl 可正常下载，Happy Eyeballs 的 IPv4 回退被 socket timeout 提前中断。

source_issues.title: Displayed module not found (cli.js)
source_issues.evidence: Windows 上 npm init playwright@latest 在安装浏览器阶段报 Cannot find module '@playwright/test/cli.js'，脚手架安装中断。

source_issues.title: PathLike file contents fail when passed inside upload tuples
source_issues.evidence: 元组 (filename, Path(...)) 中 PathLike 内容未被规范化,传给 httpx 后抛 'WindowsPath' object has no attribute 'read'。

source_issues.title: Skills single-file ZIP uploads are dropped during file extraction
source_issues.evidence: client.skills.create(files=("skill.zip", bytes)) 静默丢失文件并构造空 JSON body,仅在包成 list 后才生效,且异步同理。

source_issues.title: LanceDBVectorStore.delete(), delete_nodes(), and get_nodes() build invalid SQL predicates — broke after lancedb#3825 changed double-quote parsing
source_issues.evidence: doc_id = "item1" 现被解析为列名，delete_ref_doc() 对所有输入无条件失败，Schema error: No field named item1；新安装解析到 lancedb 0.38 即触发；该包仅锁住 0.371 因此 CI 未捕获。

top_pain_points.topic: Redis-backed multi-instance message bus is unreliable: resume/wakeup events can be duplicated or permanently lost, the WakeupDispatcher can exhaust the Redis connection pool, and the CancelDispatcher silently stops listening after a Pub/Sub disconnect
top_pain_points.summary: In multi-instance deployments sharing one Redis, the XRANGE+XDEL drain is non-atomic, so HITL confirmations and external tool results can be applied twice or lost forever (session hangs indefinitely). Slow-tool offload can spawn unbounded detached retry tasks that exhaust the Redis connection pool and halt event processing; transient Pub/Sub disconnects permanently kill the cancellation/interrupt listener until process restart.
top_pain_points.review_reason: These are production-exposed failures in the message-bus/event layer that either execute user-confirmed side effects twice, permanently lose tool results leaving sessions hung, exhaust the Redis pool halting event processing, or silently drop cancellation signals. All four cause main-flow blocking or data-correctness loss in multi-instance deployments, with real stacktraces and production evidence.

source_issues.title: Resume triggers (HITL/external tool results) can be duplicated or permanently lost in multi-instance deployments
source_issues.evidence: Reported real failures: destructive tool call confirmed via HITL may execute twice against stale state, or be lost forever leaving session parked indefinitely.

source_issues.title: WakeupDispatcher can exhaust the Redis connection pool during slow-tool offload
source_issues.evidence: Production batch evaluation service hit redis MaxConnectionsError 'Too many connections'; dispatcher loop crashed and stopped processing events.

source_issues.title: CancelDispatcher stops listening after a Pub/Sub disconnect
source_issues.evidence: Transient Redis disconnect permanently stops cancel/interrupt loop; later cancellation signals go unhandled while process still looks started.

source_issues.title: InMemoryMessageBus.try_lock ignores ttl_secs, so a crashed holder blocks the key forever
source_issues.evidence: In-memory bus lease never expires, so the key stuck for process lifetime, work never executes again; dev vs Redis behavior diverge.

source_issues.title: Resume injects synthetic "Continue from where you left off." / "No response requested." entries for outputFormat json_schema sessions
source_issues.evidence: 生产服务每次 resume 注入并累积一对合成条目，被回放给模型，合成 user 消息构成模型可执行的虚假指令，且无受支持的规避方式

source_issues.title: SessionStart hook (Options.hooks) never fires for a streaming-input query() session
source_issues.evidence: streaming-input session 中 SessionStart 永不触发，其他 hook 均正常，跨几十个真实会话独立验证为恒 0

source_issues.title: Inline-comment buffer uses a fixed /tmp path that leaks comments across runs (and repos)
source_issues.evidence: 某 run 产 0 issue 却报告 Found 9 buffered inline comments 并尝试把仓库 A 的私有评论发到仓库 B 的 PR；缓冲 body 含另一仓库的 file paths 和 code excerpts，仅靠 GitHub 422 未发到错误 PR

source_issues.title: ACP: session file written with agent-generated sessionId instead of the client-established one — session/load fails with 'Invalid session identifier' (Zed as ACP client)
source_issues.evidence: Zed 用 --experimental-acp 启动，客户端与 agent 生成不同 sessionId，磁盘上的会话文件只有 agent 的 ID，每次面报 playback 恢复失败，仅一次临时代码注入？不：此处为 Zed 每次调用 session/load 都失败，线程关闭后无法续聊，实测恒复现。open。

source_issues.title: Resuming a session (-r) sends every tool result twice: toolCalls[].result and the recorded functionResponse turn are both replayed
source_issues.evidence: `-r` 恢复会话时每个工具结果被发送两次（toolCalls[].result 与 functionResponse turn 都回放），导致后续模型上下文重复。open。

source_issues.title: [Feature] Add a write-ownership extended capability to langgraph-checkpoint-conformance
source_issues.evidence: 两个进程同一 thread + durability='sync' + Postgres：A 被 SIGSTOP，B 完成，A 解冻后两者写同一 task_id，先写者胜出，A 的写被静默丢弃却报告成功，链分叉、B 已返回的答案与线程矛盾。两者 exit 0，无报错无日志。InMemorySaver/AsyncPostgresSaver/自定义 saver 均报 conformance FULL。

top_pain_points.topic: 磁盘空间不足时 version-check 写缓存抛未捕获 OSError，阻断 aider 正常启动
top_pain_points.summary: 两个用户因磁盘空间不足（/home/plankcla/.aider 目录 No space left on device），aider 在 check_version 写版本缓存时 mkdir 抛未捕获 OSError，工具启动即崩溃，无法进入正常流程；非关键的版本检查失败却终止了整次运行且无优雅降级。
aliases: LLM 生成代码静默出错
MSIX python 无法读取插件目录
SDK blocks forever without error or timeout
SSH 断线后 ACP 无法恢复
hookify 脚本缺失 deny 所有调用
query hangs on prompt generator error
security-guidance Windows 全 hook 失败 ENOENT
steps 无法 JSON 导出
子进程泄漏导致崩溃循环

top_pain_points.review_reason: 虽然'磁盘已满'本质是用户环境问题，但 aider 对非关键版本检查的缓存写入失败没有优雅降级，而是抛未捕获异常使整个工具无法启动，两位用户都因此被阻断。体现了健壮性不足：不应让一次可忽略的版本缓存写入失败终止主流程。属低频环境相关痛点，故 P2。

source_issues.title: Uncaught OSError in pathlib.py line 1313
source_issues.evidence: traceback：main->check_version->VERSION_CHECK_FNAME.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) 在 /home/plankcla/.aider 上抛 OSError [Errno 28] No space left on device，未捕获导致进程退出。

source_issues.title: Uncaught OSError in pathlib.py line 1313
source_issues.evidence: 同版本 0.86.2、同路径 traceback，均在 /home/plankcla/.aider/caches 创建处抛 No space left on device 未捕获，块住启动。

source_issues.title: A valid multi-file edit is silently discarded if the response merely mentions an unrelated existing file (whole/editor-whole formats, non-interactive --yes-always)
source_issues.evidence: 用户给出完整可复现用例：get_file_mentions() 对 Makefile 中 'cc -o out src/foo.c' 返回 {'src/foo.c'}，对 '#include "bar.h"' 返回 {'include/bar.h'}，均因文本包含文件名而误判。'--yes-always' 下 confirm_ask 自动确认添加所有文件，reflected_message 使函数在 apply_updates() 之前返回，响应被整体放弃。实测：3 文件任务模型首次正确完成，却两次零应用零提交，会话因上下文耗尽结束，正确与错误内容全未应用。

source_issues.title: [BUG]: Anthropic prompt adapter ignores `{{ variables }}` in str system messages, sending the literal template as the `system` kwarg
source_issues.evidence: 两份独立验证器在 HEAD 上均复现：anthropic system = 'You are {{ persona }}.' 而 openai system = 'You are a pirate.'；PromptVersion.format(sdk='anthropic') 返回字面模板，直接把未替换变量发给模型。

source_issues.title: PromptTemplate.render emits Python repr instead of JSON for non-string variables
source_issues.evidence: 渲染结果 content 为 Python repr（单引号）而非 JSON，例如 'Context: {'text': 'hello', 'n': 1}'；直接调用 PromptTemplate.render 这一文档化用法时 judge 模型与下游 JSON 解析都会收到错误格式。

source_issues.title: [BUG]: F_STRING prompt templates with a stray brace or unresolved path return a masked internal server error instead of a client error
source_issues.evidence: applyChatTemplate 只捕获 TemplateFormatterError，F_STRING 的 stray brace 抛 ValueError/AttributeError 被当作 internal server error；生产开启 masking 时 errors[0].message == 'an unexpected error occurred'，evaluator 同样受影响，模板错误无法定位。

source_issues.title: Ingest replicas can deadlock each other on trace/session range updates (PostgreSQL)
source_issues.evidence: 4 comments；给出完整机制（span.py 中 Trace 行 FOR NO KEY UPDATE、project_sessions UPDATE）、preconditions（两个及以上 ingest 副本 + 同 session span 跨批边界到不同副本）、consequence：deadlock detected 40P01，aborted 侧 span 静默丢失（200 已返回），并附两 psql 会话可复现步骤；retention 删除反序锁同样死锁。

top_pain_points.topic: tabby vulkan 版本在部分 Linux 发行版上启动即崩溃（model 注册表 JSON 反序列化失败）
top_pain_points.summary: Tabby vulkan 版在 Fedora Linux 44 上启动时 panic 崩溃，报错 'Failed to fetch model organization <TabbyML>: Failed to get JSON'，原因是对 GitHub API/模型注册表返回的 JSON 反序列化失败（invalid type: map, expected a sequence），导致用户完全无法启动使用 tabby。
top_pain_points.review_reason: 这是明确的启动崩溃：用户按官方教程配置 tabby vulkan，程序仍然在启动阶段 panic 退出，主流程被完全阻断，无法使用工具，属于可感知的阻断性用户痛点。但因单条且 marked bug-unconfirmed（未确认是否普遍复现），置信度与影响评级下调为 P1，避免误标 P0。

source_issues.title: tabby vulkan not launching on fedora
source_issues.evidence: 用户报告按教程安装 vulkan 与同步 tabby 后，启动即 panic 于 registry.rs:64 'Failed to fetch model organization <TabbyML>: Failed to get JSON'，底层错误 'invalid type: map, expected a sequence at line 177 column 6'，无法启动使用。

source_issues.title: [Bug][macOS][multi-agent] Startup auth sync overwrites agent-local credentials; UI/session state can diverge from actual agent binding
source_issues.evidence: 可复现：完全退出 ClawX 后经 OpenClaw CLI 为次代理写入独立 key(KEY_B)，启动 ClawX 后两个 agent 的 SQLite auth_profile_store.store_json 都被改写为主代理的 KEY_A，毫秒级批量写入，无需模型调用。上游 OpenClaw issue #146511 经 source 审查确认为 ClawX 责任（provider-runtime-sync.ts 无 agent id 广播写入）。影响：凭据性数据丢失、成本归属不可靠、provider 限流隔离被击穿；CLI 看似成功但 ClawX 静默替换凭据。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: ClawX v0.5.6 Gateway cannot start when openclaw.sqlite was created by a newer OpenClaw version
source_issues.evidence: 复现：安装并运行 OpenClaw 2026.9.1 创建/迁移状态库后安装 ClawX v0.5.6 启用 Gateway，ClawX 反复尝试启动 Gateway 后退出。日志：openclaw.sqlite 使用 schema version 15，而该构建仅支持 1；doctor --fix 失败，Gateway 不可用。标注为 bug。

source_issues.title: bug: Extension crashes on Windows startup (TypeError: ... (reading 'includes')) blocking all models
source_issues.evidence: 扩展在 Windows 启动时 handleMessage 抛未捕获 TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'includes')，阻塞加载 config，侧边栏永久显示 'Select model - No models configured'，Portable Mode 干净环境仍复现。

source_issues.title: Bug: Turkish Locale Crash - Header name must be a valid HTTP token ["openaı-organization"]
source_issues.evidence: 土耳其语 locale 下 openai-node SDK 将 OpenAI-Organization 转成带无点 ı 的 header 名，导致 TypeError: Header name must be a valid HTTP token，发送任意消息即刻崩溃。

source_issues.title: IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2.1 : Continue crashes
source_issues.evidence: IntelliJ 2026.2.1 启动时 Continue 插件抛 java.lang.NoClassDefFoundError: com/intellij/ui/jcef/JBCefApp 崩溃（1.0.67 版本），含完整崩溃堆栈、8 条评论。

source_issues.title: PyCharm can't run the Continue plugin properly
source_issues.evidence: PyCharm 2026.2.2 + Continue 1.0.67 下无法配置 AI、无法输入 API key，插件界面不可用。

source_issues.title: Plugin whose init() returns None crashes tool init with an unattributed AttributeError
source_issues.evidence: 真实复现：tool.init() 返回 None 后，下一行 tool.register_hooks() 抛出 `AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'register_hooks'`，traceback 不包含插件名/工具名；一个插件的契约违规会拖垮整个 init_tools() 启动流程，表现为整组 setup 报错。工具 init 属于插件公开接口，第三方插件触发此问题导致 gptme 主流程（工具初始化）被阻断。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Agent SQLite WAL grows to 1.4–2.8 GB in days despite wal_autocheckpoint=1000; blocks gateway startup (Windows, 2026.9.2/9.3)
source_issues.evidence: 单 agent 数据库 WAL 两周内涨到 2865MB→wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE) 归零后两天又回到 1477MB; 97% 为同一页面重复覆写、检查点从未运行; gateway 进程存活但 281s 后仍不绑定端口, /healthz 返回 ECONNREFUSED, 日志停止增长; 只有手动离线 (独占锁) wal_checkpoint 才能解锁; 且用户明确指出 openclaw doctor 在 2.8GB WAL 阻止 gateway 绑定端口时毫无报告, 无法自动诊断

source_issues.title: [verification] HIGH: @claude-flow/cli@alpha --version times out (>60s, SIGTERM) in cold-cache npx
source_issues.evidence: `npx -y @claude-flow/cli@alpha --version` 在冷缓存环境 60s 后 SIGTERM 退出码 143，无任何输出；影响新用户/CI 首次安装的主路径。

top_pain_points.topic: 专家（Expert）凭证/技能连接流程导致 agent 运行被阻断或已安装技能被误删除
top_pain_points.summary: 专家特性在多个路径上失败：同一 provider 的第二次凭证请求永远得不到已授予的凭证（#14615）、第二张卡片加入联动行时字段不被写入（#14620）、失败的 Hub 技能安装会误删同名且安装成功的库技能（#14611）、关闭 hire-experts 标志后仍保留门禁并隐藏其指向的工具（#14573）、find_library_agent 在分页后过滤导致已安装工作流失效报告为 0（#14572）。
top_pain_points.review_reason: 这些缺陷以具体方式剥夺用户对专家运行的控制：运行被缺少的凭证阻塞、已成功安装的库技能被误删除、关闭功能开关后门禁仍拒绝并隐藏修复手段——直接影响关键功能可用性，虽多由自动审查发现但描述了确切的用户可见失败场景。

source_issues.title: CodingTools run_shell allows arbitrary command execution via chr()-encoding bypass of the restricted-mode command disallowlist (CWE-78, CVSS 9.8)
source_issues.evidence: chr() 编码绕过静态黑名单，python -c 经 subprocess.run(shell=True) 在主机执行任意命令；restrict_to_base_dir=True 为默认值，远程提示注入即可触发，无确认门控，CVSS 9.8。

source_issues.title: CodingTools run_shell allows argument injection to escape the restrict_to_base_dir sandbox via skipped flag tokens (CWE-88, CVSS 9.8)
source_issues.evidence: 跳过所有 flag token 以绕过 base_dir 路径边界校验，-c 内可携带越界文件写入并升级为任意命令执行。

source_issues.title: CodingTools: inline interpreter code (e.g. python -c) bypasses the restricted-mode command allowlist and base-dir check
source_issues.evidence: 内联解释器代码绕过受限模式命令允许列表与 base-dir 检查。

source_issues.title: [Security] CodingTools: RCE via interpreter flag injection in _check_command (allowlist bypass)
source_issues.evidence: 解释器 flag 注入绕过 _check_command 允许列表实现 RCE。

source_issues.title: run_shell _check_command can be bypassed with newline in command
source_issues.evidence: 命令中换行符可绕过 _check_command 校验。

source_issues.title: Hard coded base URL overrides ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL
source_issues.evidence: 设置 ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL 路由到 LLM 网关的用户，评论分类步骤仍直连 api.anthropic.com；截断 api.anthropic.com 的企业网络下该调用失败

source_issues.title: Authenticate git without writing the installation token into .git/config
source_issues.evidence: 审查 untrusted 代码的工作流已通过 persist-credentials:false 和 sandbox 机制避免 token 落盘，但 action prepare 又把 token 写回 .git/config；不可信代码可读取携带 job 权限的 token

signals.topic: 因依赖/运行环境不兼容（litellm 新增异常类未同步进 aider 的 exceptions 列表、缺少 propcache 模块），aider 启动即未捕获崩溃
signals.summary: 两个不同根因的启动崩溃：aider 0.86.2 调用 litellm 时因 litellm 新增的 PermissionDeniedError 不在 aider.exceptions 列表中而 ValueError 崩溃；另一用户因 yarl 依赖的 propcache.api 模块缺失导致 ModuleNotFoundError 崩溃。均在启动/初始化阶段未捕获异常，工具无法运行。
signals.review_reason: 这两类都是依赖版本漂移/打包不完整导致 aider 在启动阶段未捕获崩溃、用户完全无法运行的核心问题。litellm 异常清单不同步会随主流依赖更新影响大量用户，propcache 缺失直接影响启动。虽为两个不同根因，但共同构成'依赖不兼容阻断启动'这一可感知痛点。

source_issues.title: Uncaught ValueError in exceptions.py line 71
source_issues.evidence: macOS 上 aider 0.86.2 运行时在 send_message 内 LiteLLMExceptions().__init__ 抛 ValueError('PermissionDeniedError is in litellm but not in aider's exceptions list')，说明 litellm 升级后新增异常类与 aider 硬编码的异常清单不同步，启动/运行即崩。

source_issues.title: Uncaught ModuleNotFoundError in _url.py line 22
source_issues.evidence: Windows 10 上启动时 litellm 懒加载进而 yarl _url 导入 'from propcache.api import under_cached_property' 失败，ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'propcache.api'，在 models.validate_environment 阶段崩溃，未捕获。

signals.topic: macOS arm64 上因 scipy 原生模块 _spropack dlopen 加载失败，aider 在构建仓库图(pagerank)时启动即崩溃
signals.summary: 两个用户在同一根因上崩溃：aider 0.86.2 在 macOS 上构建 repo map 调用 networkx pagerank 时，scipy 的 _propack 扩展 .so 加载失败（'section __DATA/__thread_bss has a zero-fill section type, but offset field is not zero'），抛出未捕获 ImportError，工具无法运行。
signals.review_reason: 两位独立用户因同一 scipy 原生库在 macOS 上的安装/构建不兼容而在启动构建仓库图时崩溃，工具完全不可用，属打包发布层面的启动崩溃。虽为单一根因且同仓，但影响为启动阻断、多次出现，且与依赖打包质量直接相关。

source_issues.title: Uncaught ImportError in _svdp.py line 23
source_issues.evidence: 两个用户完全相同 traceback：get_repo_messages->get_repo_map->get_ranked_tags->nx.pagerank->to_scipy_sparse_array->scipy.sparse.linalg._svdp->_propack._spropack dlopen 失败。分属 pipx(python 3.12.8) 与 uv(python 3.12.7) 安装的 macOS arm64 环境，均因同一 .so 加载错误崩溃。

source_issues.title: Uncaught ImportError in _svdp.py line 23
source_issues.evidence: 同根因、同 traceback，分属 .local/pipx 与 .local/share/uv 两个安装路径，均报 _spropack.cpython-312-darwin.so 的 __DATA/__thread_bss zero-fill 段 offset 错误。

signals.topic: 磁盘空间不足时 version-check 写缓存抛未捕获 OSError，阻断 aider 正常启动
signals.summary: 两个用户因磁盘空间不足（/home/plankcla/.aider 目录 No space left on device），aider 在 check_version 写版本缓存时 mkdir 抛未捕获 OSError，工具启动即崩溃，无法进入正常流程；非关键的版本检查失败却终止了整次运行且无优雅降级。
signals.review_reason: 虽然'磁盘已满'本质是用户环境问题，但 aider 对非关键版本检查的缓存写入失败没有优雅降级，而是抛未捕获异常使整个工具无法启动，两位用户都因此被阻断。体现了健壮性不足：不应让一次可忽略的版本缓存写入失败终止主流程。属低频环境相关痛点，故 P2。

source_issues.title: Uncaught OSError in pathlib.py line 1313
source_issues.evidence: traceback：main->check_version->VERSION_CHECK_FNAME.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) 在 /home/plankcla/.aider 上抛 OSError [Errno 28] No space left on device，未捕获导致进程退出。

source_issues.title: Uncaught OSError in pathlib.py line 1313
source_issues.evidence: 同版本 0.86.2、同路径 traceback，均在 /home/plankcla/.aider/caches 创建处抛 No space left on device 未捕获，块住启动。

signals.topic: whole/editor-whole 多文件编辑因输出偶然提到无关文件而被整体静默丢弃，导致本应正确的编辑全部丢失（--yes-always 下触发 token 崩溃并最终什么都没应用）
signals.summary: 在 whole/editor-whole 编辑格式（含 --architect + editor-whole）下，模型完整复制的文件内容中若恰好出现仓库中其他文件的路径/唯一 basename，check_for_file_mentions() 的朴素文本扫描会误判为请求添加该文件；--yes-always 自动确认后在 apply_updates() 前丢弃整个响应，正确的多文件编辑全部丢失，多次提及时会耗尽上下文导致会话以零编辑结束。用户用真实本地模型复现：模型首次就正确的 3 文件任务仍两次得到零应用、零提交。
signals.review_reason: 这是明确的功能丢失/数据丢失型用户痛点：模型表现完全正确时，仅因响应文本包含无关文件名，用户本已正确的多文件编辑会被静默丢弃，非交互式 CI/agent 场景下会连续触发并因 token 耗尽整场会话最终什么都没应用。用户已附可无 LLM 确定性复现的最小用例，并在真实模型下端到端验证两次失败，用户影响直接且严重。虽为单 issue，但影响为静默数据丢失（非仅安全/性能），故保留。

source_issues.title: A valid multi-file edit is silently discarded if the response merely mentions an unrelated existing file (whole/editor-whole formats, non-interactive --yes-always)
source_issues.evidence: 用户给出完整可复现用例：get_file_mentions() 对 Makefile 中 'cc -o out src/foo.c' 返回 {'src/foo.c'}，对 '#include "bar.h"' 返回 {'include/bar.h'}，均因文本包含文件名而误判。'--yes-always' 下 confirm_ask 自动确认添加所有文件，reflected_message 使函数在 apply_updates() 之前返回，响应被整体放弃。实测：3 文件任务模型首次正确完成，却两次零应用零提交，会话因上下文耗尽结束，正确与错误内容全未应用。

signals.topic: 提示词模板渲染向 LLM 传递未替换的变量、非 JSON 内容或被掩盖的错误
signals.summary: 多处 Prompt 模板渲染路径存在缺陷：#16228 中 Anthropic prompt adapter 对存储为 str 的 system 消息不替换 {{ variables }}，直接把字面模板作为 system kwarg 发给模型；#16047 中 PromptTemplate.render 对非字符串变量用 Python repr 而非 JSON 序列化，把 {'text': 'hello'} 这类无效 JSON 喂给 judge 模型；#16182 中 F_STRING 模板的语法/字段错误被掩盖为 internal server error，在生产开启 PHOENIX_MASK_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERRORS 时客户端只看到 'an unexpected error occurred'，无法定位模板问题。三类都直接破坏提示词正确性并难以排查。
signals.review_reason: 是用户痛点：这些 bug 实际发生在把提示词交给 LLM 的关键路径上——Anthropic adapter 把未替换的字面 {{ }} 发出去、直接渲染出非 JSON 内容喂给 eval judge 模型、以及模板书写错误在生产被掩盖成无法排查的 'unexpected error'。会导致提示词执行结果错误、评估失真、并显著增加调试成本，且均附可复现脚本，属于反复出现的真实使用问题而非纯需求。

source_issues.title: [BUG]: Anthropic prompt adapter ignores `{{ variables }}` in str system messages, sending the literal template as the `system` kwarg
source_issues.evidence: 两份独立验证器在 HEAD 上均复现：anthropic system = 'You are {{ persona }}.' 而 openai system = 'You are a pirate.'；PromptVersion.format(sdk='anthropic') 返回字面模板，直接把未替换变量发给模型。

source_issues.title: PromptTemplate.render emits Python repr instead of JSON for non-string variables
source_issues.evidence: 渲染结果 content 为 Python repr（单引号）而非 JSON，例如 'Context: {'text': 'hello', 'n': 1}'；直接调用 PromptTemplate.render 这一文档化用法时 judge 模型与下游 JSON 解析都会收到错误格式。

source_issues.title: [BUG]: F_STRING prompt templates with a stray brace or unresolved path return a masked internal server error instead of a client error
source_issues.evidence: applyChatTemplate 只捕获 TemplateFormatterError，F_STRING 的 stray brace 抛 ValueError/AttributeError 被当作 internal server error；生产开启 masking 时 errors[0].message == 'an unexpected error occurred'，evaluator 同样受影响，模板错误无法定位。

signals.topic: PostgreSQL 多副本摄入互相死锁并静默丢失 span 数据
signals.summary: #16113 在 PostgreSQL 多 ingest 副本部署下，span 插入与 trace/session 时间范围更新在同一批事务内按到达顺序加锁，两个副本接收同一 session/trace 的 span 跨批边界时以相反顺序获取相同行，PostgreSQL 检测死锁后中止一侧，该 span 已回 SDK 200 却静默丢失（per-span savepoint rollback、无重试）。负载均衡下的常规使用即可触发，且 retention 删除也会与 ingest 形成同类死锁，造成生产数据丢失与写入卡顿。
signals.review_reason: 是用户痛点：在 Phoenix 典型的多副本 PostgreSQL 高可用/负载均衡生产部署中，摄入线程互相死锁导致 span 数据静默丢失——SDK 已收到 200 但写入被回滚且无重试无告警，直接影响可观测性数据完整性与关键功能（在线评估、趋势分析）的数据基础，同时反复死锁会拖慢整体写入，属数据丢失级阻断且带可复现证据；因去重后仅 1 条 issue 与单仓，故不标 P0。

source_issues.title: Ingest replicas can deadlock each other on trace/session range updates (PostgreSQL)
source_issues.evidence: 4 comments；给出完整机制（span.py 中 Trace 行 FOR NO KEY UPDATE、project_sessions UPDATE）、preconditions（两个及以上 ingest 副本 + 同 session span 跨批边界到不同副本）、consequence：deadlock detected 40P01，aborted 侧 span 静默丢失（200 已返回），并附两 psql 会话可复现步骤；retention 删除反序锁同样死锁。

signals.topic: Agent 执行块在运行时抛出不明确的 BlockUnknownError 而失败（无效/过期模型 ID、缺失鉴权头、第三方 API 4xx/超时、迭代错误），阻断用户的自动化运行且缺少可操作诊断
signals.summary: AutoGPT 平台大量 issue 表明用户配置或执行 agent 时，各执行块（LLM、Ideogram、Twitter、FactChecker、SendWebRequest 等）在运行中以无法定位的 BlockUnknownError 失败，包括模型 ID 无效或过期、Authorization 头缺失、401/400、连接超时以及 async_generator 迭代错误，导致运行中断且无指引。
signals.review_reason: 这是核心执行主流程的反复失败：用户运行 agent 时块直接失败，其中无效/过期模型 ID 并非代码 bug 而是配置漂移，但用户只看到晦涩的 BlockUnknownError（#12884 明确描述用户无法理解错误、误以为产品故障），运行无法继续，属于阻断性、反复出现的用户痛点。

signals.topic: 专家（Expert）凭证/技能连接流程导致 agent 运行被阻断或已安装技能被误删除
signals.summary: 专家特性在多个路径上失败：同一 provider 的第二次凭证请求永远得不到已授予的凭证（#14615）、第二张卡片加入联动行时字段不被写入（#14620）、失败的 Hub 技能安装会误删同名且安装成功的库技能（#14611）、关闭 hire-experts 标志后仍保留门禁并隐藏其指向的工具（#14573）、find_library_agent 在分页后过滤导致已安装工作流失效报告为 0（#14572）。
signals.review_reason: 这些缺陷以具体方式剥夺用户对专家运行的控制：运行被缺少的凭证阻塞、已成功安装的库技能被误删除、关闭功能开关后门禁仍拒绝并隐藏修复手段——直接影响关键功能可用性，虽多由自动审查发现但描述了确切的用户可见失败场景。

signals.topic: 计划/定时 agent 任务意外触发或无法控制（重新雇佣专家恢复用户已暂停的调度、移除工作流后残留调度仍执行并扣费、暂停调度无法从面板恢复、调度列表查询缓慢）
signals.summary: 专家定时例程在用户未授权的场景下继续运行：重新雇佣（re-hire）专家会恢复用户曾主动暂停的调度导致再次扣费；移除工作流后残留调度仍持续触发被删工作流产生计费；暂停的调度无法从面板恢复只能删除；REST 调度列表需全量扫描 jobstore 拖慢用户界面。
signals.review_reason: 用户主动暂停/取消的定时任务在未经请求时重新执行并产生计费（#14577 与 #14607 均明确提到在用户以为已取消的节奏上继续花费资金），同时面板缺少恢复入口（#14613），属于明显的成本损失与关键功能（调度控制）不可用，且多个独立 issue 证实为反复问题。

signals.topic: 核心数据块静默损坏或丢失传给 agent 的数据（ReadSpreadsheetBlock Excel 读取、SendWebRequestBlock 结构化 JSON 解析）
signals.summary: ReadSpreadsheetBlock 将字面值如 N/A/NULL/NaN 静默置空（7/8 行丢状态）、整列因空值上转为浮点使 12 变 12.0、只读首个工作表、skip_columns 永远无效、Excel 分支忽略配置的分隔符；SendWebRequestBlock 无法解析 application/*+json（如 problem+json、vnd.api+json），将结构化对象作为字符串传给下游块。
signals.review_reason: 这些块静默丢失或篡改数据而不报任何错误，用户得到错误/空白的 agent 结果却无法察觉，属于数据完整性问题——#14638 给出精确复现（7/8 行丢失、整数变小数），#14007 给出一致复现，直接影响核心数据管线的正确性。

signals.topic: ExecuteCodeBlock 在上游数据含 emoji（UTF-16 代理对）时于用户代码运行前崩溃（UnicodeEncodeError）
signals.summary: 当上游块（如 NotionReadDatabaseBlock）返回的属性值含 emoji 时，变量注入机制把输入序列化进 AGPT_VARIABLES 环境变量，Python 3.13 的 os.environ.setitem 抛 UnicodeEncodeError: surrogates not allowed，ExecuteCodeBlock 在用户代码执行前即崩溃。
signals.review_reason: emoji 是常见用户数据，含 emoji 的上游输入使 ExecuteCodeBlock 在代码运行前直接崩溃，用户代码根本不会执行，属于阻断性、真实可复现的失败（含 stacktrace 与根因），单 issue 故置于 P2。

signals.topic: tabby vulkan 版本在部分 Linux 发行版上启动即崩溃（model 注册表 JSON 反序列化失败）
signals.summary: Tabby vulkan 版在 Fedora Linux 44 上启动时 panic 崩溃，报错 'Failed to fetch model organization <TabbyML>: Failed to get JSON'，原因是对 GitHub API/模型注册表返回的 JSON 反序列化失败（invalid type: map, expected a sequence），导致用户完全无法启动使用 tabby。
signals.review_reason: 这是明确的启动崩溃：用户按官方教程配置 tabby vulkan，程序仍然在启动阶段 panic 退出，主流程被完全阻断，无法使用工具，属于可感知的阻断性用户痛点。但因单条且 marked bug-unconfirmed（未确认是否普遍复现），置信度与影响评级下调为 P1，避免误标 P0。

source_issues.title: tabby vulkan not launching on fedora
source_issues.evidence: 用户报告按教程安装 vulkan 与同步 tabby 后，启动即 panic 于 registry.rs:64 'Failed to fetch model organization <TabbyML>: Failed to get JSON'，底层错误 'invalid type: map, expected a sequence at line 177 column 6'，无法启动使用。

signals.topic: ClawX 启动时的鉴权同步会覆盖次代理的本地 API key，造成多代理凭据隔离失效与数据丢失
signals.summary: ClawX 桌面应用启动时 syncAllProviderAuthToRuntime() 无 agent 作用域地广播写入 provider key，把已存在的主代理 key 写入所有匹配 profile 的次代理 SQLite auth_profile_store，导致 per-agent credential 隔离静默塌缩、成本归属与限流隔离失效，且无任何警告。
signals.review_reason: 这是经 source 审查确认、可独立复现的凭据数据丢失问题：用户为次代理配置的独立 API key 在 ClawX 重启后被静默覆盖，属于关键配置/凭据不可用且不可见的数据损失，直接影响成本归属与限流隔离。鉴于 count=1 且为单仓，虽不满足 P0 频次门槛，但属 P1 明显且非阻断的主流程数据完整性问题。

source_issues.title: [Bug][macOS][multi-agent] Startup auth sync overwrites agent-local credentials; UI/session state can diverge from actual agent binding
source_issues.evidence: 可复现：完全退出 ClawX 后经 OpenClaw CLI 为次代理写入独立 key(KEY_B)，启动 ClawX 后两个 agent 的 SQLite auth_profile_store.store_json 都被改写为主代理的 KEY_A，毫秒级批量写入，无需模型调用。上游 OpenClaw issue #146511 经 source 审查确认为 ClawX 责任（provider-runtime-sync.ts 无 agent id 广播写入）。影响：凭据性数据丢失、成本归属不可靠、provider 限流隔离被击穿；CLI 看似成功但 ClawX 静默替换凭据。

signals.topic: ClawX 多代理桌面 UI 与会话状态与后端实际绑定不一致，用户无法从界面判断当前代理
signals.summary: 后端代理 binding 已正确切换后，ClawX 可视化 UI 仍显示陈旧/模糊的旧代理；后端会话数据存在的对话也未能展现于 UI。用户仅凭 GUI 无法可靠回答『此会话当前连接哪个代理』，需手工 JSON/plist/SQLite 检查或重启确认，多代理操作不可靠。
signals.review_reason: 多代理桌面应用的核心场景是以 GUI 作为控制平面，但 UI 绑定与会话状态与后端发散，用户无法从界面确认当前代理、会话可能无故从 UI 消失，必须依赖手工文件级检查或重启——这是体验显著下降且关键状态不可见的问题。虽同为单 issue 聚合（count=1 单仓），属 P1 明显影响。

source_issues.title: Chat content disappears, requires restart to recover
source_issues.evidence: 历史相关 issue，指示前端/会话状态在桌面多代理流程中仍存在分歧。

source_issues.title: multi-agent UI mismatch: UI header can show a non-default agent while the Workspace browser displays the default agent's workspace
source_issues.evidence: 另一个仍在开放的同类多代理 UI 状态不一致问题。

source_issues.title: [Bug][macOS][multi-agent] Startup auth sync overwrites agent-local credentials; UI/session state can diverge from actual agent binding
source_issues.evidence: 后端正确绑定到最新次代理后，视觉 UI 仍显示陈旧/模糊代理；会话在后端状态存在但 ClawX UI 缺失。用户无法仅从 GUI 回答『此会话连接哪个代理』，需重启/低级文件检查确认，使多代理 GUI 作为控制面不可信任。

signals.topic: ClawX Gateway 因 openclaw.sqlite 由更新的 OpenClaw 版本创建而无法启动并陷入重启/doctor 循环
signals.summary: 当 ~/.openclaw/state/openclaw.sqlite 由更新的 OpenClaw(2026.9.1, schema v15) 创建、而 ClawX v0.5.6 捆绑 OpenClaw 2026.7.1-2(schema 1) 时，Gateway 启动即退出(exit 78)，doctor --fix 同样失败，ClawX 反复尝试启动后退出，用户的应用与 Gateway 完全不可用。
signals.review_reason: 这是主流程启动阻断：用户若曾用较新 OpenClaw 生成过状态目录，ClawX 桌面应用的核心 Gateway 功能完全无法启动，且自动修复(doctor --fix)也失败并陷入反复重启循环，应用基本不可用。属于关键功能不可用的明确用户影响，虽单仓单 issue(count=1) 不达 P0 频次，但阻断性强，定为 P1。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: ClawX v0.5.6 Gateway cannot start when openclaw.sqlite was created by a newer OpenClaw version
source_issues.evidence: 复现：安装并运行 OpenClaw 2026.9.1 创建/迁移状态库后安装 ClawX v0.5.6 启用 Gateway，ClawX 反复尝试启动 Gateway 后退出。日志：openclaw.sqlite 使用 schema version 15，而该构建仅支持 1；doctor --fix 失败，Gateway 不可用。标注为 bug。

signals.topic: Chat formatters emit malformed conversation history (orphaned/misordered tool messages, empty text parts) causing strict LLM providers to reject the whole request with HTTP 400, breaking multi-turn and parallel-tool conversations
signals.summary: Multiple formatter bugs produce invalid message sequences (role='tool' without preceding tool_calls, promoted multimodal user messages inserted mid parallel-tool batch, empty text/function-response parts, duplicate option labels) that OpenAI-compatible (DeepSeek/DashScope/Moonshot/Volcengine) and Gemini providers reject with 400. Because the reply is stored in memory, every subsequent request in the same session also fails, stalling the conversation.
signals.review_reason: These are repeated, confirmed runtime failures where a valid agent turn (especially parallel multi-tool calls) produces a malformed request that the provider rejects with HTTP 400, and because the bad history is retained in session memory, the entire conversation becomes unusable. This directly blocks the core chat/tool flow across multiple major providers, with concrete error messages and repros.

source_issues.title: OpenAIChatFormatter: orphaned role="tool" message when self-paired Msg has empty content_blocks/tool_calls
source_issues.evidence: DeepSeek rejects request with 'role tool must be response to preceding tool_calls' 400; occurs intermittently in multi-turn multi-tool conversations.

source_issues.title: Media from a parallel tool result splits the tool messages, so the next request is rejected
source_issues.evidence: OpenAI/DashScope/Moonshot/Volcengine formatters insert user media message between sibling tool messages; request rejected with 400; every later request in session fails.

source_issues.title: GeminiChatFormatter sends parallel function responses as separate user turns
source_issues.evidence: Gemini 400 'number of function response parts must equal function call parts'; parallel function calls broken.

source_issues.title: GeminiChatFormatter emits empty text parts rejected by Gemini
source_issues.evidence: Empty TextBlock produces {'text': ''} rejected with 400 'contents.parts must not be empty' after streaming interruption.

source_issues.title: Multimodal tool results promoted mid-batch break parallel tool_calls (400 on DeepSeek & other strict OpenAI-compatible providers)
source_issues.evidence: Inserting user system-reminder between sibling tool messages of an open tool batch yields intermittent 400s on otherwise healthy sessions.
